head: Tipo
Frase con if
Frase principal
Ejemplo
rows: Zero: siempre es verdad
if + present simple
present simple
If you heat ice, it melts.
First: posibilidad real
if + present simple
will + verbo
If it rains, I'll stay at home.
Second: imaginaria
if + past simple
would + verbo
If I had more money, I'd buy a boat.

blocks.title: Nunca will en la frase con if
blocks.text: Igual que en español (si llueve mañana, nunca si lloverá), después de if nunca va will: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay at home. Pero ojo con when, as soon as, before, after, until: donde el español usa el subjuntivo (cuando llegue, en cuanto termine), el inglés usa el present simple: when I arrive, nunca when I will arrive.

Para algo que puede pasar de verdad: If you study, you'll pass. If we don't leave now, we'll miss the train. What will you do if she says no? En lugar de will también puede ir un imperativo o un verbo modal: If you see Tom, tell him to call me. If you're tired, you can go to bed.

head: Palabra
Ejemplo
Español
rows: unless
I won't go unless you come with me.
No iré a menos que vengas conmigo.
when
When I get home, I'll call you.
Cuando llegue a casa, te llamo. (pasará seguro)
if
If I see him, I'll tell him.
Si lo veo, se lo digo. (quizá)
as soon as
I'll text you as soon as I arrive.
Te escribo en cuanto llegue.

blocks.title: si = if, cuando = when
blocks.text: Como en español, if (si) es para lo que quizá pase y when (cuando) para lo que pasará seguro: When I'm 18, I'll learn to drive. Y unless ya es negativo: a menos que vengas = unless you come, nunca unless you don't come.

Para algo que no es verdad o es muy improbable: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world. (Probablemente no me tocará.) If I lived in London, I'd go to the theatre every week. (No vivo en Londres.) El past simple de la frase con if no habla del pasado: es el si tuviera, si viviera del español.

blocks.label: con would
examples: I would go if I had time.
We'd go more often if it were cheaper.
Iríamos más a menudo si fuera más barato.
You would go if you could.

blocks.title: If I were you = yo que tú
blocks.text: Para dar un consejo se dice If I were you, I'd ... (Yo que tú ..., Yo en tu lugar ...). En inglés cuidado se usa were para todas las personas: If she were here ... Al hablar también se oye If I was.

blocks.title: Un solo would
blocks.text: El español pone el condicional solo en la frase principal (Si tuviera dinero, viajaría), y el inglés igual: If I had money, I would travel. Nunca If I would have money. Piensa: si tuviera = if I had.

rows: If it will rain, we stay at home.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
Nada de will después de if; will va en la frase principal.
If I would have time, I would help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
Nada de would en la frase con if.
I'll call you when I will arrive.
I'll call you when I arrive.
Después de when: present simple.
If I am you, I would go.
If I were you, I would go.
Un consejo: If I were you.
Unless you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
unless ya significa 'si no'.
If I'm 18, I'll get my licence.
When I'm 18, I'll get my licence.
Pasará seguro: when.
If you heat water to 100 degrees, it would boil.
If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils.
Un hecho: zero conditional.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
items.full: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.

items.q: If you mix red and blue, you ______ purple.
items.full: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

items.q: If I ______ more time, I would learn the piano.
items.full: If I had more time, I would learn the piano.

items.q: If I were you, I ______ take the job.
items.full: If I were you, I would take the job.

items.q: We'll miss the train ______ we leave now.
items.full: We'll miss the train unless we leave now.

items.q: I'll phone you ______ I get home.
items.full: I'll phone you as soon as I get home.

items.q: If she studies hard, she ______ pass.
items.full: If she studies hard, she will pass.

items.q: What ______ you do if you won the lottery?
items.full: What would you do if you won the lottery?

items.q: If I ______ you, I'd see a doctor.
items.full: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.

items.q: If we lived by the sea, we ______ swim every day.
items.full: If we lived by the sea, we would swim every day.

items.q: ______ I'm in London, I'll visit the British Museum.
items.full: When I'm in London, I'll visit the British Museum.

items.q: If you're hungry, ______ yourself to some bread.
items.full: If you're hungry, help yourself to some bread.

items.q: Si llueve, me quedo en casa.
items.a: If it rains, I'll stay at home.
If I were you, I would go.

items.q: Si tuviera más dinero, me compraría una casa.
items.a: If I had more money, I would buy a house.

items.q: No iré a menos que vengas conmigo.
items.a: I won't go unless you come with me.
